name: Fingal
intro: Fingal sits between Rye and Cape Schanck on the Peninsula's ocean-coast flank. It has two separate thermal destinations: Peninsula Hot Springs and Alba Thermal Springs & Spa. Book a bathe, add a round at Moonah Links if golf is your thing, then give the rest of the day some breathing room. The venues are spread out, so Fingal works best as a planned stop or a quiet overnight base.
factualLede: Fingal is a Mornington Peninsula locality between Rye and Cape Schanck, home to Peninsula Hot Springs, Alba Thermal Springs & Spa and Moonah Links golf resort.

tldr: Fingal has two distinct thermal venues - Peninsula Hot Springs and Alba Thermal Springs & Spa - plus Moonah Links golf resort nearby.
Best for: thermal wellness weekends, golf stays, couples who want luxury without Sorrento's crowds.
Choose and book a thermal visit, then leave room for a round at Moonah Links or a quiet meal.
Two nights minimum - Fingal is about slowing down, not covering ground.
notFor: anyone who wants to walk to dinner
worstTime: peak summer weekends - reserve a preferred bathing time in advance and check current availability
signature: The Peninsula's thermal heart - where the weekend slows all the way down.
skip: Expecting a walkable town centre. Fingal's venues are spread out.
bestDay: Book a morning bathe at Alba or Peninsula Hot Springs, make time for lunch, then settle into a quiet afternoon or a round at Moonah Links.
insiderNote: Peninsula Hot Springs recommends booking ahead, especially for weekends and peak holiday periods. Check its current calendar and prices before travelling; same-day bathing bookings carry a surcharge.
